title: Crush: inspected sessions/messages row subset
description: Known exported columns of plural sessions/messages tables, not a complete DDL specification. This is a partial observational reference, not a vendor-certified or lossless ingestion schema. Unknown properties are allowed.

session_id.description: Owning session of a message row.

anyOf.description: Parent session; top-level session discovery can filter this to NULL.

cost.description: Source cost value; unit and aggregation must be verified before financial interpretation.

created_at.description: Source numeric creation time; normalize units according to actual schema/version.

role.description: Message role: user, assistant, system, tool, or unknown.

parts.description: JSON-encoded part array; decode using the parts reference.

anyOf.description: Whether this message is a summary.
